comparison.interpretation: Compare slope and local-relief distributions at similar coarse spatial support. Do not compare absolute elevation across different vertical datums or Earth DSM and Mars areoid height. This is not a rover-safety or landing-suitability assessment.
comparison.spatial_support_note: MOLA 64 px/degree is approximately 0.93 km north-south and 0.91 km east-west near Nili Patera. Copernicus DEM GLO-30 is a DSM averaged to 0.925 km. The 30 km windows are a local terrain sample, not the entire Syrtis Major quadrangle.
